question: Which statement describes monitoring Fibre Channel traffic on a Cisco UCS 6332 Fabric Interconnect?
options: Fibre Channel traffic is monitored only on one vHBA per server.
Fibre Channel traffic is capable to be monitored as it is encapsulated as FCoE.
The monitoring of Fibre Channel traffic is limited to the default VSAN.
The destination port for monitoring must be an unassigned Fibre Channel port.
theory: On a Cisco UCS 6332 Fabric Interconnect, native Fibre Channel traffic inside the unified fabric is carried encapsulated as FCoE over the same Ethernet/DCE infrastructure used for LAN traffic. Because of this encapsulation, FC traffic monitoring (SPAN) is not limited to a single vHBA, the default VSAN, or unassigned FC-only destination ports — instead, monitoring works on the encapsulated FCoE frames the same general way Ethernet SPAN does, which is the key characteristic tested here. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 12 — Cisco UCS Traffic Monitoring, Fibre Channel over Ethernet)
